summary.business_type: Editorial/reference site (programmatic country x category etiquette-rule database, Astro static on Cloudflare Workers)
top_findings: datePublished is fabricated in production - all 84 pages show the identical timestamp, likely a shallow git clone in the Cloudflare Workers Builds pipeline
Site may not be indexed by Google at all - site:etiquetteness.com returns zero results, no technical blocker found
dateModified and sitemap lastmod are uniformly today's date across all 84-107 URLs, carrying zero differentiation signal
Schema gaps widened: author/publisher/Organization still absent, about field still an invalid bare string, and country + category hub pages (20 total) ship zero JSON-LD
Hub pages remain link directories, not synthesized guides - unresolved page-type mismatch for broad '[country] [category] etiquette' queries
quick_wins: Submit sitemap in Search Console and request indexing on 5-10 URLs - zero code change, addresses the indexation blocker
Add Organization + publisher/author schema site-wide, referenced from every Article - source content already exists in prose on /about/
Add long-lived immutable caching for /_astro/* and /og/* via public/_headers - recommended at baseline, still not live
Add /llms.txt indexing the 6 categories, 14 countries, and 84 entries
Investigate Cloudflare Workers Build git-clone depth to fix the datePublished bug, or fall back to a frontmatter publishedAt field

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy) all confirmed live
Internal-link trailing-slash redirect eliminated - trailingSlash: 'always' verified through canonicals, links, and breadcrumbs
robots.txt clean, sitemap valid and referenced, canonicals correct and self-referential everywhere, no noindex anywhere
Duplicate meta descriptions fixed - category/country pages now have unique, content-specific descriptions
Thin content substantially improved - unique body text grew from ~560 to ~2,200 characters on sampled articles
og:image/twitter:image live with real per-entry PNGs; twitter:card upgraded to summary_large_image
Sitemap now emits lastmod for all 107 URLs
Brotli compression, HTTP/3, self-referencing canonicals all confirmed healthy

findings.title: Site indexing status unconfirmed - site: query returns zero results
findings.description: No technical blocker found (robots.txt, meta robots, X-Robots-Tag, canonicals, sitemap all clean); a google-site-verification DNS TXT record confirms GSC ownership was verified at some point, but nothing indicates the sitemap was ever submitted.
findings.recommendation: Submit sitemap-index.xml in Search Console, run URL Inspection + Request Indexing on 5-10 representative URLs, check the Page Indexing report for exclusion reasons.

findings.title: datePublished fabricated in production - identical timestamp on every article
findings.description: src/lib/publishedDates.ts correctly derives a real per-file first-commit date via git log --diff-filter=A, but production returns the same value for every one of 84 sampled pages, matching the deployed HEAD commit exactly - strongly indicates a shallow git clone in Cloudflare Workers Builds.
findings.recommendation: Deepen the Workers Builds git checkout (fetch-depth: 0 equivalent) or fall back to a frontmatter publishedAt field set once per entry.

findings.title: Residual 307 redirect + 2-hop chain for non-canonical/external URLs
findings.description: No longer hit by internal navigation, but any external backlink, bookmark, or typed URL using the pre-fix format still pays a 307, or a 2-hop chain when combined with http://.
findings.recommendation: Override with an explicit 301/308 Worker rule; collapse the http + non-slash case into a single hop.

findings.title: Hashed static assets and OG images still not cached long-term
findings.description: /_astro/*.css, /pagefind/pagefind-ui.js, and now /og/*.png all served with max-age=0, must-revalidate despite content-hashed or effectively-immutable filenames.
findings.recommendation: Add public/_headers rules: 31536000/immutable for /_astro/* and /pagefind/*, and a shorter revalidatable window for /og/*.

findings.title: /search/ still thin and indexable
findings.description: Returns 200, listed in sitemap, but raw HTML has no real content - Pagefind results render client-side only. No noindex directive present.
findings.recommendation: Add noindex,follow and drop from sitemap.

findings.title: Article structured data still missing author
findings.description: image, datePublished, and dateModified are now present but author is absent from every sampled Article block.
findings.recommendation: Add an Organization author (e.g. {"@type":"Organization","name":"Etiquetteness"}).

findings.title: CSP relies on 'unsafe-inline' for script-src
findings.description: Otherwise well-configured CSP includes 'unsafe-inline', weakening its core XSS-mitigation value - likely required for the inline Pagefind bootstrap script.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to a nonce- or hash-based CSP entry for that one inline script.

findings.title: Empty 404 page body
findings.description: Returns 404 with content-length: 0 - security headers present but no HTML body, nav, or search box.
findings.recommendation: Ship a real 404 page.

findings.title: /contact/, /privacy/, /terms/ still 404
findings.description: Not inherently an SEO defect, but the site is now a public repo under MIT/CC-BY-NC - a Privacy/Terms or attribution page is increasingly expected.
findings.recommendation: Add minimal Contact and Privacy pages.

findings.title: IndexNow protocol still not implemented
findings.description: No IndexNow key file found.
findings.recommendation: Cheap, optional add given the static build/deploy pipeline.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Substantive /about/ page (~280 words) states sourcing/verification methodology and a corrections path
Article body copy 3-4x longer (200-253 words vs 50-72) with exceptions, a 'watch out for' list, and a new 'Why it matters' section
Country and category hub pages now have real, unique editorial copy instead of ~0 words
Internal contextual linking expanded beyond same-country - new 'More [category] rules' cross-country block
Content grew from 58 to 84 entries, all 13 live countries now have 5+

findings.title: datePublished fix does not work in production
findings.description: Every article on the live site shows the identical datePublished timestamp despite the underlying git history being genuinely staggered per file - same root cause as the Technical finding.
findings.recommendation: See Technical category fix.

findings.title: dateModified/updatedAt uniformly today's date across all 84 entries
findings.description: Grepping updatedAt: across every .mdx file returns the same date for all 84 entries, including ones untouched in the recent content push - a rolling build date, not a genuine edit date.
findings.recommendation: Only bump updatedAt on substantive content edits going forward, not on unrelated commits.

findings.title: Single external source per entry, still secondary/blog-tier
findings.description: All sampled entries cite exactly one source each, consistently a travel-blog-tier citation rather than a primary/institutional source.
findings.recommendation: Add a second corroborating source where feasible, or favor embassy/cultural-institute/academic sources.

findings.title: No Contact, Privacy, or Terms pages
findings.description: All still 404. /about/ now covers most of the 'who/how to reach us' role a Contact page would, downgrading this from Critical.
findings.recommendation: Add a standalone /contact/ and a minimal /privacy/ given the site loads third-party analytics.

findings.title: No named individual author or credentials anywhere
findings.description: About page and footer point to a GitHub handle and email - real improvement over anonymity, but no stated name, background, or claimed expertise.
findings.recommendation: Add a name/handle and a one-line credibility statement, visible on-site.

findings.title: Severity tag (strict/casual) has no defined legend
findings.description: No glossary, tooltip, or methodology text explaining the distinction anywhere, including the new About page.
findings.recommendation: Add 1-2 sentences to the About page's 'How an entry gets made' section.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Meta descriptions now unique per category/country page (was site-wide duplicate)
Real heading structure per article: H1 rule statement, intro paragraph(s), Do/Don't list, H2 'Why it matters' section
BreadcrumbList present and correct on every article, now using canonical trailing-slash URLs
Internal linking expanded across both same-country and same-category axes

findings.title: Hub pages are link directories, not synthesized guides
findings.description: Country/category hub intros are now real 2-3 sentence editorial copy, but still hand off to a bare list of links rather than an inline synthesized answer - the core mismatch for broad head-term queries per the SXO pass.
findings.recommendation: Add narrative synthesis between the entry list, or a new country x category intersection page.

findings.title: No question-phrased headings
findings.description: The new 'Why it matters' section is a real improvement but is not phrased as a natural-language query, missing the highest-leverage remaining AI-citability change.
findings.recommendation: Add or rename to a question-based H2 per entry.

findings.title: Do/Don't list coverage inconsistent
findings.description: Present on roughly 2/3 of sampled entries; the rest ship as list-free prose.
findings.recommendation: Roll the pattern out to the remaining entries - template already proven.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: image on Article fixed - real per-entry OG PNG verified live and correctly sized
datePublished/dateModified mechanism fixed (dateModified no longer computed at request time) - though datePublished's data is currently wrong in production, see Content/Technical
Breadcrumb name casing fixed - title-cased via COUNTRY_META instead of raw slug
/about/ ships valid AboutPage JSON-LD

findings.title: Country and category hub pages ship zero JSON-LD
findings.description: Confirmed live via curl on both /country/japan/ and /category/dining/ - zero application/ld+json blocks. Doubles the previously-scoped category-only gap to 20 pages total.
findings.recommendation: Add CollectionPage + BreadcrumbList + ItemList to both hub templates.

findings.title: about field still an invalid bare string on Article schema
findings.description: Live JSON-LD shows "about":"japan" - schema.org's about range is Thing, not Text. Same unresolved fix from baseline.
findings.recommendation: Swap for { "@type": "Country", "name": countryLabel } - countryLabel already computed in the template.

findings.title: author still missing on Article
findings.description: No author property, no byline anywhere in rendered HTML.
findings.recommendation: Add an Organization author, referencing a new sitewide Organization entity.

findings.title: No Organization or publisher entity anywhere
findings.description: No Organization exists to reference as publisher/author despite /about/ now containing exactly the needed prose (name, methodology, GitHub, contact).
findings.recommendation: Add an Organization block once (e.g. on the homepage) and reference its @id from Article publisher/author and the About page's mainEntity.

findings.title: Homepage WebSite block has no SearchAction
findings.description: No potentialAction despite a working /search/ page.
findings.recommendation: Add a SearchAction pointing at /search?q={search_term_string}.

findings.title: No license property reflecting the new CC BY-NC 4.0 status
findings.description: Site went public with dual licensing (MIT code, CC BY-NC 4.0 content) but this isn't reflected in schema anywhere.
findings.recommendation: Add a static license URL to the Article schema.

findings.title: mainEntityOfPage and @id missing
findings.description: Not added on Article or hub pages.
findings.recommendation: Add once the Organization/publisher work lands.

categories.name: Performance (proxy/lab)
what_works: Trailing-slash redirect on internal links resolved - no more double round-trip on internal navigation
Security headers verified to add no measurable overhead
Per-entry OG images confirmed zero-runtime-cost - pre-rendered at build time, served like any static asset
New homepage hero image well-implemented: responsive srcset, explicit width/height, fetchpriority=high
Brotli compression, HTTP/3, and TTFB all confirmed healthy (~450ms, directional only)

findings.title: Hashed assets and images still not sent with long-lived caching
findings.description: /_astro/*.css and the new hero image/OG image files all served with max-age=0, must-revalidate. Flagged at baseline, still unimplemented, now covers more surface area.
findings.recommendation: Add a public/_headers rule for 31536000/immutable on /_astro/*.

findings.title: Render-blocking Google Fonts stylesheet
findings.description: Synchronous font CSS load on every page, unchanged since baseline.
findings.recommendation: Self-host the two variable woff2 files with preload.

findings.title: pagefind-ui.js loads without defer
findings.description: 120KB script on /search with no defer/async attribute.
findings.recommendation: Add defer.

findings.title: Orphaned React client bundle in build output
findings.description: @astrojs/react is installed and bundled but no page currently hydrates a React island - zero real-world cost today, but flagged as build hygiene.
findings.recommendation: Confirm if planned scaffolding or prune the dependency.

findings.title: No real CWV field/lab data available
findings.description: No Lighthouse/PSI/CrUX access in this environment across two consecutive audits - all findings remain proxy estimates.
findings.recommendation: Re-run with real tooling once available.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: AI crawlers (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, etc.) all allowed via robots.txt, no blocking
Passage length grew substantially - core answer blocks now 77-163 words, near the citation-optimum range
New 'Why it matters' section on every sampled page gives a distinct, independently-citable second passage
Do/Don't lists now present on most sampled pages
/about/ gives AI systems something concrete to cite as methodology, and site is openly MIT/CC-BY-NC licensed

findings.title: Multi-modal content remains the weakest dimension
findings.description: Per-entry OG images exist but are never rendered inline with alt text - zero img/figure/video/table elements on any sampled article. Sitemap declares an image namespace but has zero image:image entries.
findings.recommendation: Add image:image sitemap entries pointing at existing OG images (low effort); consider embedding illustrative in-body images with alt text.

findings.title: No Organization/Person schema, despite the source content existing on /about/
findings.description: Homepage JSON-LD is still WebSite-only, Article schema has no publisher/author/sameAs - the single largest remaining authority gap, and low-effort given /about/ already has the needed prose.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization schema and reference it as publisher/author sitewide.

findings.title: llms.txt still missing
findings.description: 404, unchanged from baseline - content is now even better suited to an llms.txt index given its consistent URL pattern and 84-entry scale.
findings.recommendation: Add a static llms.txt listing the site summary, CC BY-NC 4.0 terms, and category/country links.

findings.title: datePublished/dateModified/lastmod all still unreliable in production
findings.description: Same fabricated-freshness issue flagged by Technical/Content - undercuts an AI system's ability to cite 'as of' dates.
findings.recommendation: See Technical category fix.

findings.title: No question-based headings for query-mapping
findings.description: 'Why it matters' is real content but not phrased as a natural-language query an AI system can map directly onto.
findings.recommendation: Add or rephrase toward question-based H2s.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Per-entry OG images now exist and are real, correctly-sized 1200x630 PNGs (verified live, not placeholders)
Homepage hero image well-implemented with responsive srcset, explicit dimensions, and correct loading priority
OG image generation confirmed zero-runtime-cost - build-time satori+resvg, not computed per-request

findings.title: Zero in-body images across all 84 article pages
findings.description: OG images exist only as social-share/schema metadata, never rendered inline with alt text - flagged independently by Content, GEO, and SXO passes, despite the content type (bowing, cheek-kissing, hand placement) being inherently visual.
findings.recommendation: Add at least one illustrative image per article with descriptive alt text; the existing OG generation pipeline could plausibly be adapted.

findings.title: OG images not exposed via image sitemap
findings.description: Sitemap declares an xmlns:image namespace but has zero image:image entries across all 84 URLs.
findings.recommendation: Add image:image entries pointing at existing OG image URLs - data already exists.

findings.title: Category and article pages (excluding homepage) remain entirely text-only
findings.description: Only the homepage has an image; every category, country, article, and search page has zero img tags.
findings.recommendation: Prioritize article-page images first given they're the primary Google/AI landing surface.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Submit sitemap to Search Console and request indexing on 5-10 URLs

Add Organization + publisher/author schema site-wide, referenced from every Article
Fix the about field type mismatch on Article schema (bare string to Country entity)
Add JSON-LD to country and category hub pages (CollectionPage + BreadcrumbList + ItemList)

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add long-lived immutable caching for /_astro/* and /og/* via public/_headers
Add /llms.txt indexing categories, countries, and entries
Stop overwriting updatedAt to today's date on every build - only bump on real edits
Build real guide-depth content at the hub layer (synthesized country x category guides)
Roll the Do/Don't list pattern out to remaining entries; add question-phrased H2s
Add image:image sitemap entries for existing OG images
Add Contact and Privacy pages

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add at least one illustrative in-body image per article with alt text
Add a second corroborating source per entry where feasible
Put a name/handle and one-line credibility statement visible on-site
Add a legend for the strict/casual severity tag
Fix residual 307 redirect for non-canonical/external URLs (301/308)
De-index /search/ (noindex, drop from sitemap)
Run seo-programmatic skill on the country x category matrix at current scale
Re-run a scoped pass on Brazil/Vietnam once deployed

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Ship a real 404 page body
Self-host Google Fonts with preload
Add defer to pagefind-ui.js
Add www DNS record + redirect to apex
Add IndexNow protocol
Re-run Performance and SXO with real Lighthouse/CrUX/PageSpeed and a full SERP sweep once available
Begin off-site brand-mention building
Decide on the orphaned React client bundle - keep or prune
